cards.card_text: Then the rest of the Kohathites, the Gershomites and the Merarites get towns from tribe after tribe, so the Levites end up with towns on both sides of the Jordan.
cards.verse_text: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
